data.name: NARROWS: Naval Checkpoint Simulator
data.detailed_description:
INDEPENDENT TRADERS ALLIANCE

NOTICE OF APPOINTMENT — CHECKPOINT OFFICER, THE NARROWS

Trade must flow. The Alliance is looking for a new checkpoint officer to see that it does.

THE POST

You will serve alone at the Narrows Checkpoint, controlling the ship traffic through the strait.

Each day, ships arrive seeking passage. Not all of them are cleared. Smart captains look for ways to fake an entry; some will try to smuggle contraband through the Narrows.

It is your job to sort them. Clear the approved. Stop the rest. Keep the lane moving at any cost.

Regional relations are, at present, in a period of adjustment. Officers should expect conditions to intensify over the course of their posting; hazard bonuses will be applied accordingly.

REQUIREMENTS

The Narrows is a high-volume posting. The Alliance seeks officers who meet the following criteria:

  • Registry proficiency: Must be able to operate the vessel registry and cross-reference documentation against records on file without assistance.

  • Acute vision: Strong unaided eyesight is essential. Much of what distinguishes a compliant vessel from an irregular one will not appear in its paperwork.

  • Sound judgment under pressure: Officers will make consequential decisions rapidly, repeatedly, and alone. Hesitation reduces throughput.

  • Composure in isolation: The post offers no relief, no partner, and no immediate support. Candidates must remain effective across extended solitary shifts.

  • Discretion: Officers will encounter sensitive traffic and sensitive offers. The Alliance expects its representatives to conduct themselves appropriately at all times.

  • Adaptability: Standing orders are subject to change without notice. The ability to comply with revised directives immediately is required.

*Excessive misconduct or suspicion of corruption may result in early termination of contract.
*Officers are prohibited from leaving their post until their contract is fulfilled.
*This notice was generated automatically by TradeGPT. The Alliance assumes no responsibility for its contents.

data.short_description: Trade has flowed through the Narrows for centuries, now it's yours to command. Inspect every ship, check for contraband, deal with smugglers and pirates. With war on the horizon, every choice has its cost, choose well.

pc_requirements.minimum:

  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • Processor: Intel i5-12600 or AMD Ryzen 5 5600
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 3050 or AMD Radeon RX 5500
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • Processor: Intel i7 12700 or AMD Ryzen 7 7700
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 3060 or AMD Radeon RX 6600
